precepts.text: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people. Come out of her, my people. Get your head out of Christianity. Get your head out of the philosophies. Get your head out of this thinking that your vote is going to mean something. You Israelites, you better get your mind right in terms of what the Most High is about to bring on this earth. The Lord said for us to gather ourselves together. Yea, gather together, O nation not desired. He is not asking in that scripture. He says, Gather together. That is a commandment. That is a direct order. He says, Gather yourselves together, O nation not desired. None of the nations desire us. None of them. So we are obligated to come together in righteousness. We are obligated to follow the programme in this Bible. That ye be not partakers of her sins. Zephaniah is saying the same thing, that ye be not partakers of her sins.
precepts.point: Flee out of the midst of Babylon. This is the same thing that is said in Revelation. These three scriptures are saying the same thing.

note.label: The Exponential Maturation In The Days Of Decadence

precepts.why:
Jeremiah says “Flee out of the midst of Babylon”, and Revelation says the same thing: “And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people”. Revelation, Zephaniah and 2 Corinthians are three scriptures saying the same thing.

Come out of her, my people. Get your head out of Christianity. Get your head out of the philosophies. Get your head out of this thinking that your vote is going to mean something. You Israelites, you better get your mind right in terms of what the Most High is about to bring on this earth.

“that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” That is the “be not cut off in her iniquity” of Jeremiah: don't be partakers of her sins, and don't be destroyed when that evil comes. Zephaniah is saying the same thing with “Before the decree bring forth”: so that you don't get caught up in the judgments. That's the point.

And the way out is the order the Lord gave: gather together, O nation not desired. He is not asking; that is a commandment, a direct order. None of the nations desire us, none of them. So we are obligated to come together in righteousness and to follow the programme in this Bible. We are in the time of the Lord's vengeance now, and coming out of her is how every man delivers his soul.

precepts.text: This is why it is saying, Flee out of the midst of the philosophies of Babylon the Great. It ain't necessarily talking about getting on a plane and going somewhere, because this whole earth is corrupted, but it means come out of the philosophies of how this system has got us thinking. That is the whole point: how we think. Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired. But the question is, gather yourselves together. Before the decree bring forth. In other words, that ye be not partakers of her plagues. It is saying the same thing in different words. Before the decree bring forth, before the destruction comes. Before the day pass as the chaff, before the destruction. Before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you. In other words, you have to do this so that you do not get caught in those things there.
precepts.point: Flee out of the midst of Babylon. This is the same thing that is said in Revelation. These three scriptures are saying the same thing.

precepts.why:
Zephaniah gives the order: “Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired”. This is why Jeremiah says, flee out of the midst of Babylon: flee out of the midst of the philosophies of Babylon the Great. It is not necessarily talking about getting on a plane and going somewhere, because this whole earth is corrupted. It means come out of the philosophies of how this system has got us thinking. That is the whole point: how we think.

“Before the decree bring forth”. In other words, that ye receive not of her plagues, as Revelation says. It is saying the same thing in different words. Before the decree bring forth means before the destruction comes. “before the day pass as the chaff”: before the destruction. “before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you”. You have to do this so that you do not get caught in those things.

That is the “be not cut off in her iniquity” of Jeremiah 51:6: be not cut off, be not destroyed when the chaff goes through. “for this is the time of the Lord’s vengeance”, and we are in that time now. He is slapping the heads of these leaders, making them look stupid and crazy, in our presence.

And how do we return? Obey his commandments and organise, as the scriptures say. Become that mature nation in exponential growth; learn how to be an organised nation among ourselves, so that when we get the kingdom we will know how to act and how to operate as a nation. We are in the training ground. We were brought into captivity to learn a lesson, because we did not want to serve our Lord; when we learn it well, we come off our punishment and enjoy the kingdom.

precepts.text: Wherefore come out from among them. Saying the same thing. Come out from among them. And be ye separate. Separate your thinking from their thinking. You are not supposed to be hanging around them, hanging out with them. That is wrong. I do not give a damn what they tell you. That is wrong. The Lord did not bring us over here for us to be hanging with them and all of that. I know that sounds like some serious racist talk, but you are the victims of every level of racism. So what is wrong with you? We are the victims of every racist attack. But yet when we say stay away from them, all of a sudden we are racist. My sons end up dead messing around with you, and I am worrying about your feelings? And touch not the unclean thing. Because if you continue to mess around in these philosophies, messing around with their religions, with their politics, messing with any of that stuff, the Bible says that it shall pollute you. And I will receive you. So we will be received in the Most High's nation. That is what he is saying. And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty. In other words, he is building that kingdom when you come away from them. That is the organisation right there. And like the scriptures say, some will lose mothers, some will lose sons, daughters, fathers. You will lose these things, but when you come into this truth you will gain them sevenfold, tenfold. Come out from among them, that is what the Bible said. And ye shall be my sons and daughters, because I am gathering you up. Like Zephaniah said, I am gathering you up, and what you lost you are going to gain it all back again.

That is how every man delivers his soul out of the midst of Babylon.

precepts.text: Go to Isaiah 14 and verse 5. This is how she made the nations drunk. The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers. He who smote the people in wrath. That is what Babylon the Great did. Babylon the Great smote the nations in her anger. That is Babylon the Great. That is what it is talking about. This is the Lucifer that we were reading about earlier. They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee. That is the same man that we are talking about, this same chapter, Isaiah 14. He who smote the people in wrath. In wrath. That is the wrath of her fornication. She basically got the nations in bed with her. I use the word fornication, because when you fornicate with a harlot you become one. So she fornicated and made the nations get in bed with her, and now they are mad and crazy because they are in love with a harlot that they cannot stand. With a continual stroke, with a continual killing. That is how America does. America continually drops bombs on people, puts embargoes against people, completely rips them off, steals their resources. Continually does that. Never lets them get up. He that ruled the nations in anger. He that America, Babylon the Great, ruled the nations in anger. That is how they talk when they get on television. Is persecuted. Now they are going to get persecuted. That is their time to come down. That is why we were reading that in Habakkuk. Shall not all these nations put up a parable against you and say, Woe unto you that increaseth that which is not yours? So they are all seeing it and they are all turning against her now.
precepts.point: The nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad. The nations are crazy. The nations are mad because their economies are destroyed. Their livelihood is destroyed. Their way of life is destroyed. They are mad because democracy and Christianity have obliterated the minds of people all around the world.

note.label: The Exponential Maturation In The Days Of Decadence

precepts.why:
Jeremiah says Babylon “hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, that made all the earth drunken”. Isaiah shows how she made the nations drunk: “The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers. He who smote the people in wrath”. That is what Babylon the Great did: she smote the nations in her anger. That is Babylon the Great. This is the same Lucifer of Isaiah 14, the same man that chapter is talking about.

“He who smote the people in wrath”: that is the wrath of her fornication. She made the nations get in bed with her, and when you fornicate with a harlot, you become one. So now they are mad and crazy, because they are in love with a harlot that they cannot stand. She put a hex on them. That is why Jeremiah says “the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.”

“with a continual stroke”: with a continual killing. That is how America does. America continually drops bombs on people, puts embargoes against people, completely rips them off, steals their resources. Continually does that, and never lets them get up. “he that ruled the nations in anger”: America, Babylon the Great, rules the nations in anger. That is how they talk when they get on television.

“is persecuted, and none hindereth.” Now they are going to get persecuted. That is their time to come down. That is why Habakkuk says all these nations will take up a parable against her: woe unto you that increaseth that which is not yours. They are all seeing it, and they are all turning against her now.

So we are in the days of their decline. Jeremiah already speaks of it in the past tense: “Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed”. They are trying to heal Babylon today with these preachers, but “she is not healed”. If it is time for her to be destroyed, our minds had better be on that righteous exponential maturation, getting ourselves ready as a nation for the coming kingdom.

precepts.text: The Most High is sick of them. He endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath, and they were made to be destroyed by God. God had to endure them parading themselves as though they are the people of God. That made the Lord mad. The Lord shall go forth as a mighty man. When the Lord gets loose from his prophecies — because remember, the Lord gave Esau his time to rule, he said until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled. When their time is up, that is when he is free to act. But before that happens he has to allow Esau — and I use the word allow. He has to watch this paramecium, I keep calling it. He has to watch this amoeba. He has to watch this germ move around like he is something great. He is sitting there watching him. He said, I want to step in now, but I cannot do it, because right now I am bound by my word. But when he is free from his prophecies, when the prophecies continue to come to pass like they are, when that number of the Israelites wake up, that is when he is free to do what we are about to read here. He shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies. I have long time holden my peace. You hear what the Lord said. I have long time holden my peace. That is the longsuffering there. I have been still, and refrained myself. Do you know what it is like to refrain yourself? He had to hold himself back. He wants to step in, but he says, I am a man of my word. But I want to get in there and deal with you now. You running around parading yourself like you are my people, like you are my sons, like you are my daughters, and I am watching you take advantage of my real children, and I am mad, but I have got to let the prophecies finish out.
precepts.point: Saying, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers. So there is no getting out of this. There is no changing. There is nothing that a preacher can do. Nobody could stop what we are about to read here. Surely the Lord said that he will fill Babylon the Great with men. As with caterpillers. What is that talking about? Terrorists. The Most High is going to have this place filled up with terrorists from the other nations that are mad because of what Babylon the Great did to their places. She smote the people in wrath and they are mad. So now they say, since you took our riches, you took our diamonds, you took our gold, you took everything from us, and then you tell us that we have got to come over to Babylon the Great to work — not only are we going to work, but we are working to get inside your system, because we are getting ready to take you down. That is how they are talking with these sleeper cells. That is what is going down. So we do not need to be playing games while all this stuff is happening.

note.label: The Exponential Maturation In The Days Of Decadence

precepts.why:
Jeremiah says to Babylon the Great, “thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness”: the measure of her evils has come up to the Lord's nostrils. God said, I am sick of you, I have had enough of you. Isaiah shows the Most High getting loose: “The Lord shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.”

He endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath, and they were made to be destroyed by God. God had to endure them parading themselves as though they are the people of God, and that made the Lord mad. Remember, the Lord gave Esau his time to rule, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled. When their time is up, that is when he is free to kick ass. Before that, he has to allow Esau. He has to watch this paramecium, this amoeba, this germ move around like he is something great. He wants to step in now, but he is bound by his word. When the prophecies come to pass like they are, when that number of the Israelites wake up, that is when he is free.

“I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself”. That is the longsuffering. Do you know what it is like to refrain yourself? He had to hold himself back. He is a man of his word, but he wants to get in there and deal with them now: you running around parading yourself like you are my people, like you are my sons and my daughters, and I am watching you take advantage of my real children, and I am mad as hell, but I have got to let the prophecies finish out.

“now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.” That now means he is free. Now he is not bound no more, now that number has come in, because the prophecies have been met. Revelation shows the same now: “the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world”. That great red dragon is Edom, Idumea, cast out of his rulership. He deceived the whole world into thinking a white image is Jesus, that these so-called white people are the Jews and the Christians, and that we, the jewels of God, are nothing. Then: “Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ”, because Esau is brought down, the times of the nations are fulfilled, and we are ready to rule.

So when Jeremiah says “The Lord of hosts hath sworn by himself”, he did not ask anybody for permission. Nothing a preacher can do can stop it. He will fill Babylon the Great with men as with caterpillers, the terrorists and sleeper cells of the nations she robbed. Whether we are ready or not, the Most High is going to bring this to pass, so we do not need to be playing games.

precepts.text: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the Lord. Watch what he calls Babylon: Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain. And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever. That right there lets you know it is not Iraq: are people still living in Iraq today? Yes. This says thou shalt be desolate for ever; so it is not talking about ancient Babylon.
precepts.point: Who art thou, O great mountain? Remember, Zerubbabel was in the Persian captivity; Babylon was already destroyed by Persia. So this great mountain is Babylon to come: Babylon the great. Does everybody understand that?

note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

precepts.why:
Zechariah asks, “Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain”. Zerubbabel was in the Persian captivity, and Babylon was already destroyed by Persia. So who is this great mountain? Jeremiah shows where the mountain is: “And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the Lord.”

Watch what he calls Babylon: “Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the Lord, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.” The great mountain is Babylon.

“And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the Lord.” That lets you know it is not Iraq. Are people still living in Iraq today? Yes. This says “thou shalt be desolate for ever”, so it is not talking about ancient Babylon.

So the great mountain before Zerubbabel is Babylon to come: Babylon the great. Before him it becomes a plain, flattened and destroyed, and it is done “Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts.” Everything we do must be according to the spirit of the Most High God; it has nothing to do with our physical powers and our skills.

precepts.text: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed; make America great again is not going to happen, America is falling.
precepts.point: Bread and circuses came before Rome fell; now it is a UFC fight on the White House lawn, the World Cup, weed legalized state by state to keep the mind docile, and sports with no breaks between seasons.

note.label: Woe to Amerikkka

precepts.why:
Jeremiah speaks of Babylon: “We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed.” That is what they are trying to do now, in every aspect: heal America, just like the Bible says. Trump, make America great again, and all that. Listen, that is not going to happen. America is falling.

The Most High is showing it. America is about to celebrate its 250 years, and the front lawn of the White House looks shabby, the East Wing is under construction, the pool they spent all that money on is green with algae, and there is a fence around it all. When we were wicked in the world and had a birthday, we got a new outfit, a haircut, everything. Your 250th year should be something grandiose, and this is what your most pristine house looks like? Every picture shows it: a broken country. As in Daniel, the clay and the iron will never mix; everybody is going back to their own countries, and war is going to break out of this place.

Why can she not be healed? Because “her sins have reached unto heaven”. America made the biggest mistake of its life: it oppressed the children of Israel, the apple of God's eye, and even when we were supposed to be freed, it held forward the affliction and never opened the doors of its prisons. Because of her sins she keeps making the wrong decisions, hardening more and more towards us, and the Most High is taking note. There is a payment to pay, and no one can heal her.

precepts.text: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come: America will not step down or meet the demands, so the Lord fills her with men as with caterpillars, the wild and crazy ones.
precepts.point: The Most High loves his people, and as the wars come, hard times are coming for the twelve tribes.

note.label: The God Of War & Salvation

precepts.why:
Prophecy is coming to pass and there is no stopping it. The wild and crazy ones made demands to the proud one: not only fall back out of our country, but pay us back for all the destruction. The proud man says no, we are not going to do that. Even while they talk about peace talks, God has them in the trick bag.

“O thou that dwellest upon many waters”: that is New Babylon, America. She is “abundant in treasures”: rich from all the nations, because they have taken all the land and all the resources and oppressed all the people. And “thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.” The Most High is already telling her that her end is come and it is time to step down. She is not going to step down, so God is going to put her down.

“The Lord of hosts hath sworn by himself”: the same Lord of hosts who is a man of war in Exodus 15:3. “Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.” Those caterpillars are the wild and crazy ones.

If proud Babylon gives in to the demands, she loses her sovereignty over the economy, and that is her downfall. Because she is prideful and already in power, she will not do it, so it leads to war, and God activates the caterpillars. Either way it goes to war. As the Lord cast Pharaoh's chariots into the sea, he will consume this enemy as stubble.

precepts.text: With violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and in her was found the blood of prophets, of saints and of all that were slain upon the earth: the prophets and saints will be killed in America, and she is the cause of all the earth's slain, as angels worked with Nebuchadnezzar's army in Ezekiel 9.
precepts.point: As Babylon caused the slain of Israel to fall, at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth: America is responsible for every war on the earth, whichever president sits, and the Russia-Ukraine war began with America dangling NATO before Ukraine and then walking away.

note.label: Trump Is Fulfilling God's Prophecy

precepts.why:
Christ said there shall be wars, famines, pestilences and earthquakes before he returns, and Jeremiah shows who is behind the wars: “As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.” Because Babylon killed the saints, America will be responsible for all the wars and deaths taking place on the earth. It is the Lord bringing these plagues, but he is using Babylon, America, to do it. No matter which president goes into office, he will do what God wants him to do. The Russia and Ukraine war began because America kept dangling the carrot of NATO before Ukraine, promising to protect it from Russia, and then Trump came in and said we ain't helping you with nothing.

John saw the end of it: “And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down”. That great city Babylon is America.

“And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.” The prophets and the saints will be killed here in Babylon, and all the wars and death on the earth, Babylon will be the cause of it: America, the oppressor.

It is the same as ancient Babylon. Nebuchadnezzar came through killing everybody, but who was behind him? The Lord. In Ezekiel 9, when the mark was set on those that sigh and cry and the rest were slain, children and all, it was not literal angels alone; it was angels working with Nebuchadnezzar's army. So too America fulfils God's prophecy, whether openly like Trump or in secret like Obama killing Gaddafi, and over thirty-eight million people have been killed by America's policies and wars since 1971. Billions will die in what is about to take place.

precepts.text: A cry from Babylon and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans, because the Lord hath spoiled Babylon and destroyed out of her the great voice. Babylon is America, the Chaldeans its ally, modern Israel; the great voice is the media that hypnotizes the world. Her mighty men are taken, and her princes, wise men, captains, rulers, and mighty men sleep a perpetual sleep, the lake of fire.
precepts.point: The serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman. His mouth is the media, every aspect of it so-called Jewish owned, and the water is lies. The flood is to draw the twelve tribes into Christian and democratic lies.

note.label: Prophesy From Pain to Peace

precepts.why:
“A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans”. Babylon here is America, and the Chaldeans are modern Israel today. The Chaldeans were always an ally to Babylon: ancient Babylon were Kushites and the Chaldeans Semites, so brought up to today, America is Babylon and the Israelis are the Chaldeans.

“Because the Lord hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice”. What is the great voice? Their media, which goes worldwide and captivates and hypnotizes people everywhere. “When her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered”: the waves are the nations within her.

“Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon”, as we read in Habakkuk, “and her mighty men are taken”, as prisoners of war, “every one of their bows is broken: for the Lord God of recompences shall surely requite.”

“And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains”, the admirals and generals, “and her rulers”, the governors and mayors, “and her mighty men”, the soldiers: “and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake”. That perpetual sleep is the lake of fire; they are never waking up again. So the serpent’s mouth, the great voice, will be destroyed out of her.

precepts.text: Flee out of the midst of Babylon and deliver every man his soul. Physically, the day may come to move to another land or city to keep the gospel moving; spiritually, flee the ways of the beast now. Deliver the real you under the sinful flesh, and do not be like Lot's wife.
precepts.point: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say the evil shall not overtake nor prevent us. Some of you carry that spirit: I am an Israelite, the Lord will give me mercy. If you fall, get back up immediately, because that mindset has this future.

note.label: The Beauty And The Beast

precepts.why:
Amos says, “All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.” That is what God said is going to happen, and there is nothing you can do to delay or undo it. So we have to come out of the beast; we have to come out of that mentality. Jeremiah says, “Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul”.

Flee out of Babylon can be physical. That day may come when we have to go to different lands: some of us will be exiles, some will be deported, and sometimes you may have to go to the next city or somewhere else to keep this gospel moving. But it is also spiritual: we have to flee out of the ways of the beast now.

“Deliver every man his soul”: the soul is the real you, underneath this sinful flesh, and the Lord is telling us to deliver it. That means letting go of the things we are accustomed to here. We cannot be like Lot's wife, who looked back and became a part of the Lord's sacrifice.
